title: Sauce Delivery shared execution contract registry

contract.name: delivery
contract.description: Registry half of the Delivery contract. The semantic module owns cross-field rules and proof evaluation.

execution-card.description: One bounded, independently releasable Delivery execution child.

fields.name: card
fields.description: Canonical card identity supplied from the note filename or intake title.

consumer_descriptions.planner: Author one unique trimmed card title; filenames and frontmatter comparisons use this identity.
consumer_descriptions.coordinator: Use the canonical normalized identity as the ledger key; never infer ownership from an identifier prefix.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Delivery contract version stamped at authoring time. Newer-than-engine versions fail closed.

fields.name: parent_card
fields.description: Explicit parent authority; wikilink, alias, and bare forms normalize to one identity.

consumer_descriptions.planner: Link the exact non-claimable parent card.
consumer_descriptions.coordinator: Compare this normalized field for sibling ownership; identifier prefixes are never authority.

fields.name: slice
fields.description: Short human navigation label within the explicit parent.

fields.name: model_profile
fields.description: Reasoning profile; independent from unattended safety policy.

fields.name: execution_mode
fields.description: Release-backed code work or explicitly supervised docs-only validation.

fields.name: batch_policy
fields.description: Machine-readable continuation ceiling. Derived policy may strengthen but never weaken it.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Normalized projection vocabulary shared by cards, boards, and coordinator phases.

fields.name: touch_zones
fields.description: Non-empty exclusive working set expressed as workspace-relative paths or {root,path} tuples.

consumer_descriptions.planner: Declare the smallest canonical path set covering every intended edit; use tuples only for multi-root work.
consumer_descriptions.coordinator: Normalize path segments and reject equality or nesting conflicts within the same logical root.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.description: Forward dependencies only. Reverse links are derived and Archive never proves completion.

fields.name: deploy_subscriptions
fields.description: Exact headspace, Accuris, and ERO component additions; empty arrays remain explicit.

fields.name: epic
fields.description: Planning authority or design artifact that explains the execution child.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Pinned evidence claims. Current claims require source identity, capture timestamp, revision or external identifier, locator, and supported claim; historical strings remain readable only with an unpinned-evidence warning.

fields.name: context_pack
fields.description: Optional versioned context-pack link; absence is backward-safe.

fields.name: release_required
fields.description: Derived true for release mode and false for docs_only; conflicting authored values are invalid.

fields.name: deployment_required
fields.description: Derived true for release mode and false for docs_only; completion proof follows the derived value.

fields.name: risk_dimensions
fields.description: Explicit high-risk dimensions. Any listed dimension requires the heavy model profile.

evidence-claim.description: A pinned snapshot supporting one claim about mutable state.

fields.name: source_identity
fields.description: Stable identity of the repository, service, vault, or authority observed.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone recording when the source was observed.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Commit, hash, receipt ID, PR/tag, or external revision pin.

fields.name: locator
fields.description: Path/line, symbol, heading, URL, or other source locator.

fields.name: claim
fields.description: Exact claim the pinned snapshot supports.

release-ancestry-receipt.description: Pinned deterministic proof that a feature PR merge is contained by the recorded release and tag.

fields.name: ok
fields.description: True only after the deterministic ancestry adapter verifies containment.

fields.name: receipt_id
fields.description: Durable identifier for this ancestry check.

fields.name: repository
fields.description: Repository identity against which ancestry was checked.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone for the ancestry observation.

fields.name: verifier_revision
fields.description: Exact deterministic engine revision that produced the receipt.

fields.name: feature_pr
fields.description: Feature PR identity tied to feature_merge_sha.

fields.name: feature_merge_sha
fields.description: Verified feature merge commit.

fields.name: release_pr
fields.description: Containing release PR identity.

fields.name: release_merge_sha
fields.description: Verified containing release merge commit.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Release tag verified against the containing release.

docs-validation-receipt.description: Pinned exact-head/base proof for supervised docs-only completion.

fields.name: ok
fields.description: True only when the documented validation passed.

fields.name: receipt_id
fields.description: Durable validation receipt identity.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 validation timestamp with timezone.

fields.name: verifier_revision
fields.description: Exact verifier revision.

fields.name: head_sha
fields.description: Exact validated head commit.

fields.name: base_sha
fields.description: Exact validated base commit.

brew-promotion-receipt.description: Pinned proof that the recorded tap PR produced the installed Homebrew version.

fields.name: ok
fields.description: True only after deterministic Homebrew verification.

fields.name: receipt_id
fields.description: Durable promotion receipt identity.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 promotion observation timestamp with timezone.

fields.name: verifier_revision
fields.description: Exact deterministic verifier revision.

fields.name: tap_pr
fields.description: Tap PR that promoted the formula.

fields.name: installed_version
fields.description: Verified Homebrew installation version.

fields.name: vault
fields.description: Exact required vault identity.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Verified vault locator.

fields.name: ok
fields.description: True only after install and status checks pass.

fields.name: required_version
fields.description: Release floor applied to this vault.

fields.name: installed_version
fields.description: Verified installed Sauce version.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 deployment start timestamp with timezone.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 deployment completion timestamp with timezone.

fields.name: status_exit
fields.description: Read-only post-install status exit code; completion requires zero.

fields.name: history_errors
fields.description: Install-history errors; completion requires an empty array.

fields.name: added_subscriptions
fields.description: Subscriptions newly inserted by this deployment attempt; may be empty on retry.

fields.name: verified_subscriptions
fields.description: Current post-install subscription snapshot used for retry-safe requested-component proof.

migration.reason: Mutable evidence cannot be pinned without source identity, capture time, revision, locator, and claim.

base_execution_card.card: A2 shared registry and semantic contract core

evidence.claim: Delivery packages as a mechanism with one registry plus pure semantic contract.

depends_on: [[A2 shared registry and semantic contract core]]
